newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close mostly lower in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close mostly lower in thin volume.

text.p: Italian shares closed mostly lower on Monday in a weak, low volume market with fading hopes of an early interest rate cut weighing on sentiment while traders mulled over the outcome of first-round municipal elections at the weekend.
The all-share Mibtel index finished 0.84 percent down at 12,075 with the blue chip Mib30 ending 0.91 percent down at 17,956. Volumes fell to to 651 billion lire from 726 billion lire on Thursday.
Fiat slid 1.29 percent to close at 5,359 lire after last week's surprise announcement of a one-for-10 bonus share issue.
Olivetti, ENI, Montedison and Pirelli were all marked down with Pirelli falling 2.72 percent to 3,647 lire and ENI 2.2 percent lower at 8,606 lire.
Brokers said foreign investors were mostly absent apart from transactions in telecommunications stocks which held up well with Telecom Italia fractionally higher, closing at 4,372 lire.
Domestic operators sold aggressively in late trading, the brokers said.
The strong showing in the municipal election of the hard line Communist Refoundation Party, which says it opposes government plans to prune welfare hand-outs, also dampened sentiment.
